meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Use this when the user asks to search memory, "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or wants work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速找回之前会话中解决过的问题和做法
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常想从过往对话里快速找回答案。
copy.tagline_en: Recall past solutions and how you did things before.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to dig up answers from earlier conversations.

howto.what: 它让 Claude 能检索你在历史会话里留下的记忆:先用 search 拿到带 ID 的索引,再用 timeline 看某条记录前后的上下文,最后只对挑中的 ID 用 get_observations 取完整内容。
howto.when: 当你问的是以往会话而非当前对话时,例如「这个之前修过吗」「上次 X 是怎么做的」等涉及历史工作的问题。

say.text: 帮我搜一下认证相关的历史记录
say.note: 调用 search,返回带 ID 的索引表

say.text: 上次 token 过期那个问题我们是怎么修的?
say.note: 先搜索,再用 timeline 看上下文

say.text: 把 #11131 和 #10942 的完整内容拉出来
say.note: 用 get_observations 批量取详情

howto.what_en: Claude can search claude-mem's cross-session memory: run search for an index with IDs, timeline for surrounding context, then get_observations for full details only on the IDs you pick, saving tokens.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about previous sessions rather than the current chat, e.g. "did we already fix this?" or "how did we solve X last time?"

say_en.text: Search my history for authentication work.
say_en.note: Runs search, returns an index table with IDs

say_en.text: How did we fix the token expiration bug last time?
